children: Citi on Thursday upgraded Arcturus Therapeutics
to Buy from Neutral after the messenger RNA medicines company reported promising mid-stage trial data for ARCT-810, its experimental therapy for a rare liver disease called ornithine
Analyst Yigal Nochomovitz also raised his price target on Arcturus
to $20 from $8 per share and increased the probability of success for the company’s OTC opportunity to 50%, citing, among other things, a favorable safety and tolerability profile for ARCT-810.

The interim Phase 2 readout released on Wednesday showed the drug’s proof of concept in OTC with up to ~42% lower ammonia and ~25% lower glutamine along with higher protein intake, Nochomovitz argued.

The analyst also welcomed the FDA's guidance to amend the company's ongoing Phase 2 study for ARCT-810 with the addition of its other OTC candidate, ARCT-2601, which utilizes its LUNAR 2.0 mRNA delivery platform.
"FDA’s agreement to integrate ARCT- 2601 patients into ARCT-810’s Ph2 should avoid a full development reset and limit cost/timeline impacts typical of formulation changes," Nochomovitz wrote.

title: Arcturus raised to Buy at Citi after mid-stage trial data for liver disease drug
